rubric.why: Identifies that an artificial satellite is made by humans.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for identifying it as a human-made object.

rubric.why: Identifies that it moves around Earth or another planet in an orbit.
rubric.description: States that it revolves in orbit around Earth or another planet.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for describing its orbital motion and what it orbits.

modelAnswer: An artificial satellite is a human-made object placed in orbit around Earth or another planet.
